create_ColorText: create a ColorText instance to wrap strings with ANSI color codes for terminal output
build_color_string: build a colored terminal string using the ColorText.color method with a specified color code
set_color: set the current color on a ColorText instance for subsequent color calls
reset_color: reset a ColorText instance's current color back to its default reset color
set_reset_color: set a custom reset color on a ColorText instance to change the default reset behavior
